source.text_it: I motori a scoppio e quelli a ciclo Diesel sono ambedue motori a combustione interna

records.localized_text: Spark-ignition and diesel-cycle engines are both internal combustion engines.

source.text_it: Il motore Diesel è un motore a combustione interna

records.localized_text: A diesel engine is an internal combustion engine.

source.text_it: I motori a combustione interna possono essere indifferentemente a due o a quattro tempi

records.localized_text: Internal combustion engines may be either two-stroke or four-stroke.

source.text_it: I cilindri sono parti meccaniche caratteristiche dei motori a combustione interna

records.localized_text: Cylinders are characteristic mechanical parts of internal combustion engines.

source.text_it: Il motore a combustione interna trasforma energia termica in energia meccanica

records.localized_text: An internal combustion engine converts heat energy into mechanical energy.

source.text_it: Un motore a scoppio può essere alimentato sia con benzina sia con gas metano

records.localized_text: A spark-ignition engine may run on petrol or methane gas.

source.text_it: I pistoni sono organi tipici di un motore a combustione interna

records.localized_text: Pistons are typical components of an internal combustion engine.

source.text_it: Le fasi di funzionamento di un motore a quattro tempi sono: aspirazione, compressione, scoppio (o combustione) e scarico

records.localized_text: The four strokes of a four-stroke engine are intake, compression, ignition or combustion, and exhaust.

source.text_it: L’albero a camme comanda l’apertura e la chiusura delle valvole

records.localized_text: The camshaft controls valve opening and closing.

source.text_it: Le valvole della distribuzione sono almeno due per ogni cilindro

records.localized_text: The valve gear has at least two valves per cylinder.

source.text_it: La valvola a farfalla di un motore a scoppio fa entrare nei cilindri la quantità di aria richiesta in base alla posizione del pedale dell’acceleratore

records.localized_text: A spark-ignition engine's throttle valve admits the amount of air required by the accelerator pedal position.

source.text_it: La rottura della cinghia dentata o della catena di distribuzione può recare gravi danni agli organi interni del motore

records.localized_text: A broken toothed belt or timing chain can seriously damage internal engine components.

source.text_it: La catena della distribuzione collega l’albero motore con l’albero della distribuzione

records.localized_text: The timing chain connects the crankshaft to the camshaft.

source.text_it: Nei motori a scoppio, i cilindri aspirano miscela di aria e benzina oppure aria e metano o aria e GPL

records.localized_text: In spark-ignition engines, cylinders draw in a mixture of air and petrol, methane or LPG.

source.text_it: Il motore a scoppio è un motore a combustione interna

records.localized_text: A spark-ignition engine is an internal combustion engine.

source.text_it: Un motore ad accensione comandata non può essere del tipo a ciclo Otto (a scoppio)

records.localized_text: A positive-ignition engine cannot be an Otto-cycle spark-ignition engine.

source.text_it: Tutti i motori a combustione interna sono dotati di iniettori

records.localized_text: All internal combustion engines have injectors.

source.text_it: Le candele a scintilla sono utilizzate sia nei motori a scoppio che in quelli Diesel

records.localized_text: Spark plugs are used in both spark-ignition and diesel engines.

source.text_it: Le bielle uniscono i pistoni con l’albero a camme

records.localized_text: Connecting rods join pistons to the camshaft.

source.text_it: Il movimento dei pistoni è un moto rotatorio

records.localized_text: Pistons move in a rotary motion.

source.text_it: I motori a combustione interna trasformano la forza motrice in calore

records.localized_text: Internal combustion engines convert motive force into heat.

source.text_it: Sono ad accensione spontanea tutti i motori dotati di candele a scintilla

records.localized_text: All engines with spark plugs are compression-ignition engines.

source.text_it: I cilindri di un motore a combustione interna devono essere sempre in numero pari

records.localized_text: An internal combustion engine must always have an even number of cylinders.

source.text_it: Se il motore è a combustione interna non ha bisogno della marmitta

records.localized_text: An internal combustion engine does not need an exhaust silencer.

source.text_it: Soltanto il motore Diesel è un motore a combustione interna

records.localized_text: Only a diesel engine is an internal combustion engine.

rows.text: In both, fuel burns inside the engine; the method of ignition differs.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: In a diesel engine, injected fuel burns in hot compressed air inside the cylinder.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: Internal combustion engines can be two-stroke or four-stroke: the number of piston strokes per cycle differs.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Fundamentals of the Diesel Cycle — cicli a due e quattro tempi e distribuzione

rows.text: In a piston engine, the cylinder houses the piston and bounds the space where compression and combustion occur.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla
https://www.briggsandstratton.com/en-gb/support/glossary — carburatore, cilindro singolo e iniezione alternativa

rows.text: Hot combustion gases expand and push the piston, producing mechanical work.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: A spark-ignition engine can use petrol or, with a suitable fuel system, methane-rich natural gas.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla
https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/natural-gas-maintenance-safety — motori a gas naturale con accensione a scintilla e alimentazione dedicata

rows.text: In common reciprocating engines, the piston moves in the cylinder and is pushed by combustion gases.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: In a four-stroke engine, intake, compression, combustion with the power stroke, and exhaust follow in sequence.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: The cams actuate the valves at the intended time; springs close them.
evidence: https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/6f4a8033-9b77-4a2b-a03e-a65851964f15/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf, Timing belts, Function — comando delle valvole e possibili collisioni con i pistoni

rows.text: In a conventional four-stroke engine, the valve gear includes at least one intake and one exhaust valve per cylinder.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Fundamentals of the Diesel Cycle — cicli a due e quattro tempi e distribuzione

https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/6f4a8033-9b77-4a2b-a03e-a65851964f15/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf, Timing belts, Function — comando delle valvole e possibili collisioni con i pistoni

rows.text: The throttle regulates intake airflow in response to the accelerator demand, affecting power.
evidence: https://www1.eere.energy.gov/vehiclesandfuels/pdfs/diesel_technical_primer.pdf, p. 1 — ciclo Otto, farfalla, accensione e iniezione diretta

rows.text: If synchronization is lost, pistons and valves can collide in some engines and suffer serious damage.
evidence: https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/6f4a8033-9b77-4a2b-a03e-a65851964f15/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf, Timing belts, Function — comando delle valvole e possibili collisioni con i pistoni
https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/f662b55a-808e-497a-ac63-0b53fd3c8cc4/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf, p. 13 — catene sincronizzano gli alberi

rows.text: The chain synchronizes the crankshaft and camshaft so the valves operate at the right time relative to the pistons.
evidence: https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/f662b55a-808e-497a-ac63-0b53fd3c8cc4/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf, p. 13 — catene sincronizzano gli alberi

https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/6f4a8033-9b77-4a2b-a03e-a65851964f15/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf, Timing belts, Function — comando delle valvole e possibili collisioni con i pistoni

rows.text: In premixed or port-injection systems, the cylinder draws in air and fuel. The quiz marks this VERO, but in direct injection the fuel enters the cylinder directly, so the mixture need not be drawn in already prepared.
evidence: https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-propane-cars-work — DOE descrive iniezione nel condotto o nella camera di combustione.
https://afdc.energy.gov/vehicles/how-do-gasoline-cars-work — DOE: benzina iniettata nel condotto o direttamente nella camera di combustione.

rows.text: In a spark-ignition engine, the mixture burns inside the cylinder and the gases push the piston.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: The Otto cycle is associated with spark ignition: a spark ignites the compressed mixture.
evidence: https://www1.eere.energy.gov/vehiclesandfuels/pdfs/diesel_technical_primer.pdf, p. 1 — ciclo Otto, farfalla, accensione e iniezione diretta

rows.text: Not all have injectors: a carburettor can prepare and supply the air-fuel mixture.
evidence: https://www.briggsandstratton.com/en-gb/support/glossary — carburatore, cilindro singolo e iniezione alternativa

rows.text: A spark plug ignites the mixture in a spark-ignition engine; in a diesel engine the fuel ignites in hot compressed air.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: The connecting rod joins the piston to the crankshaft, not the camshaft, and transmits motion.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf, DOE Fundamentals Handbook Mechanical Science, vol. 1, Diesel Engine Fundamentals, Diesel Engines, Connecting Rod e Crankshaft, pagina stampata 8 (pagina PDF 28): la biella collega il pistone all’albero motore, che converte il moto alternativo in rotazione.

rows.text: The piston moves back and forth in the cylinder; the mechanism transmits this motion to the rotating crankshaft.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla
https://www.briggsandstratton.com/en-gb/support/glossary — carburatore, cilindro singolo e iniezione alternativa

rows.text: The useful process goes the other way: combustion produces hot gases that move the piston and generate work.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: A spark initiates ignition of the mixture; in diesel compression ignition, heat from compressed air starts it.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

rows.text: An even number is not required: single-cylinder engines also exist.
evidence: https://www.briggsandstratton.com/en-gb/support/glossary — carburatore, cilindro singolo e iniezione alternativa

rows.text: Internal combustion produces exhaust gases and noise: the silencer reduces exhaust noise.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla
https://www.briggsandstratton.com/en-gb/products/engines-xr6.5 — esempio di motore a combustione con silenziatore per ridurre il rumore

rows.text: A spark-ignition engine is also an internal combustion engine: combustion occurs inside both engines.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — combustione nel cilindro, pistone, cicli e accensione Diesel e a scintilla

issues.reason: Il quesito afferma senza limitazioni che nei motori a scoppio i cilindri aspirano una miscela aria-carburante e stampa VERO. La descrizione DOE dei motori a iniezione diretta nella camera contraddice tale generalizzazione; la limitazione a sistemi con miscela formata prima dell’aspirazione non compare nel testo. Il revisore richiede una adjudicazione indipendente del conflitto prima di accettare una spiegazione.

The explanation mentions that alternative without visibly identifying the conflict or explaining the limited premixed-intake interpretation needed to preserve the printed VERO; its evidence also does not record that inferred scope. Adjudicate and explicitly flag the ambiguity in all four languages, preserving the printed verdict.
